# Amazon Bedrock AgentCore - Document History — captured 2026-07-04

WebFetch again could not render the doc-history table on 2026-07-04 (page returned only the title). Retaining cached entries; supplemented with dated confirmations from AWS What's New / release pages (via WebSearch) for reportability timing:

### June 2026 (confirmed via AWS What's New)
- **AgentCore Harness — GA** (June 2026). Managed agent-loop service: define agent with CreateHarness, run with InvokeHarness; no orchestration code / no container. GA adds built-in memory, more model providers (LiteLLM, Bedrock Mantle), AWS-curated skills catalog, evaluations & optimization, unified observability, versioning/endpoints, export to Strands code. (Preview was April 2026.) **[REPORTABLE — new agent-capability/runtime service surfaced on docs]**
- **AgentCore Optimization — new capabilities GA** (June 2026). Recommendations (optimized system prompts/tool descriptions from production traces) validated via Batch Evaluations and A/B Tests. Underlying API ops (Create/Get/List/Update/DeleteABTest, *BatchEvaluation, *Recommendation) were captured in the 2026-05-18 API cache; the Optimization *service* is newly surfaced on the docs overview. **[REPORTABLE — new agent-governance/optimization service on docs]**

### April 9, 2026
- **AWS Agent Registry** — centralized catalog for agents, MCP servers, tools, skills; governed publish/review/approve; hybrid semantic+keyword search.

### December 2, 2025
- Policy in AgentCore; Episodic memory strategy; Custom claims for Gateway auth; Bidirectional streaming (WebSocket); Gateway OAuth token support; AgentCore Evaluations; API Gateway REST stages as gateway targets.

### November 4, 2025 — Direct code deployment (Python ZIP)
### October 31, 2025 — Get started updates
### October 30, 2025 — Web Bot Auth (Preview)
### October 13, 2025 — Runtime identity service-linked role; GA
### October 10, 2025 — MCP servers as Gateway targets

### July 16, 2025 — Initial release (preview)
